location.description: ID of the location of the Kafka Connect resource.
location.rationale: Defines geographic location; does not affect access or data protection.

connect_cluster.rationale: Refers to the parent cluster, not an access control mechanism itself.

connector_id.description: The ID to use for the connector.
connector_id.rationale: Used for naming only, no impact on security posture.

configs.rationale: Misconfigured or insecure values (e.g., insecure converters or secrets) can lead to data leakage, broken encryption, or operational risks.
compliant: configs with secure serializers and authentication credentials stored externally
non-compliant: configs exposing passwords in plain text

task_restart_policy.description: Specifies how to restart failed tasks. If not set, tasks won't be restarted.
task_restart_policy.rationale: Primarily affects availability and reliability, not confidentiality or access control.
compliant: Defined backoff policies to avoid crash loops

minimum_backoff.description: Minimum time to wait before retrying a failed task. Example: "3.5s".
minimum_backoff.rationale: Availability-related; does not directly influence security posture.

maximum_backoff.description: Maximum time to wait before retrying a failed task. Example: "3.5s".
maximum_backoff.rationale: Availability-related; no access or data protection impact.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Resource scoping identifier; does not influence security directly.
